purpose: Knowledge-base-wide evaluation over carefully curated, natural, single-page text questions without document identity hints
selectionPolicy: Use answerable facts whose complete supporting evidence is on one physical page and is classified as Pure-text (Plain-text).
Ask natural questions using only the entity, product, organization, case, method, or topic that a real user is likely to know.
Do not provide a file name, document title as a retrieval instruction, documentId, page number, answer text, or hidden retrieval hint.
Exclude tables, charts, figures, visual attributes, cross-page aggregation, multi-step arithmetic, ambiguous deixis, and near-duplicate facts.
Cover varied domains and answer shapes; answer-format quotas and one-question-per-document quotas must not force low-quality questions into the set.
